**AltoClef Plus** is an unofficial add-on for [AltoClef](https://github.com/gaucho-matrero/altoclef), the bot that
plays Minecraft by itself. It runs next to AltoClef and [Baritone](https://github.com/cabaletta/baritone) without
changing their files, and makes the bot easier to control, safer and less likely to get stuck.

> AltoClef Plus is **not** made by or affiliated with the AltoClef or Baritone teams. It is built for
> **singleplayer and LAN worlds**. Only use bots on servers that allow them.

## You also need

- Minecraft **1.18.2** with **Fabric Loader 0.14+** (Fabric API is not needed)
- **AltoClef 0.4.1**: download the official release from
  [GitHub](https://github.com/gaucho-matrero/altoclef/releases/tag/v0.4.1) and put both jars from the zip in
  your `mods` folder (it includes Baritone)
- Optional: [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for a settings button in the mod list

## What it adds

- **Control panel** (Right Shift) instead of chat commands: start tasks with buttons and a searchable item
  grid, Stop (K) and Pause/Resume (O), a checklist of the bot's beat-the-game progress, and a live log.
- **Safe zones**: mark your house, farm or petting zoo by standing on two corners. The bot won't break,
  place, loot or hurt mobs there (each rule can be switched per zone).
- **Safety rules**: never attacks named mobs or tamed pets, plus mob and block lists you choose.
- **Smarter inventory**: right tool for every block, tidy hotbar, wears and crafts armor as soon as it can,
  drops only real junk, fixes eye-of-ender crafting and long walks back to old crafting tables.
- **Safer progression**: gears up before risky trips, rests when hurt, uses a shield, dodges arrows and
  carries water for falls.
- **Stuck recovery**: notices endless pillaring, mining the same block, pacing or Nether back-and-forth
  and tries something else; goes back for its items after dying.
- **Travel**: boats across oceans, enderman hunting with a boat trap, and one precise Nether trip to the
  stronghold.
- **Smooth camera** while the bot is in control; doors no longer make the bot get stuck.

Every feature can be switched off in Settings.

## Status

Early development: everything is built and unit-tested, but it hasn't had wide in-game testing yet.
Please report problems on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Creeperhouse999/Altoclef-Plus/issues).

Source: [github.com/Creeperhouse999/Altoclef-Plus](https://github.com/Creeperhouse999/Altoclef-Plus)
